```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tufte)
    # invalidate cache when the package version changes
    knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache.extra = packageVersion('tufte'), echo = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
    options(htmltools.dir.version = FALSE)
    require(ggraph)
    require(tidygraph)
    require(igraph)
    require(kableExtra)
```

```{r close, fig.height=12, fig.width=12,fig.cap="An undirected graph."}
    set.seed(12345)
    gr <- play_islands(n_islands = 5, size_islands = 3, p_within = 0.7, m_between = 2) %>% 
        simplify()
    n <- length(V(gr))
    labs <- toupper(letters[1:n])
    V(gr)$name <- labs
    p <- ggraph(gr, layout = 'auto') 
    p <- p + geom_edge_link(color = "steelblue", width = 1.15) 
    p <- p + geom_node_point(color = "tan2", size = 22) 
    p <- p + geom_node_text(aes(label = name), size = 12, color = "white")
    p <- p + theme_graph() 
    p
```
(@) Write down the **(Geodesic) Distance Matrix** for the graph shown in Figure \@ref(fig:close). [Recall that in the Distance Matrix](http://olizardo.bol.ucla.edu/classes/soc-111/lessons-winter-2022/7-lesson-from-graph-to-matrix.html#the-geodesic-distance-matrix), the $ij_{th}$ cell contains the **length** of the shortest path between nodes *i* and *j* (2pts).

```{r}
    d <- distances(gr)
    kbl(d, format = "html", padding = 1, align = "c") %>% 
        kable_classic(lightable_options = "striped") %>% 
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed", "responsive")) %>% 
        row_spec(1:n, color = "black", extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid;height:10px") %>% 
        column_spec(1:n, color = "black", border_right = TRUE, border_left = TRUE)
```
(@) Using the information in the distance matrix, compute the **closeness centrality** of each node in the graph shown in Figure \@ref(fig:close) (2pts).

```{r}
    c <- round(1/rowSums(d), 2)*length(V(gr))
    kable(c, format = "html", padding = 1, align = "c") %>% 
        kable_classic(lightable_options = "striped") %>% 
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed", "responsive")) %>% 
        row_spec(1:n, color = "black", extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid; height:60px;") %>% 
        column_spec(1:2, color = "black", border_right = TRUE, border_left = TRUE, extra_css = "vertical-align:middle;")  %>% 
        column_spec(1:2, extra_css = "text-align: center;")
```

(@) Which node has the highest closeness centrality in Figure \@ref(fig:close)?

- $A$

(@) Which node has the smallest closeness centrality in Figure \@ref(fig:close)?

- $B, C, F, I, L, M$

```{r clique, fig.height=12, fig.width=12, fig.cap="An undirected graph"}
    set.seed(123)
    gr1 <- create_complete(5) %>% 
        mutate(name = toupper(letters[1:5]))
    gr2 <- create_complete(5) %>% 
        mutate(name = toupper(letters[6:10]))
    gr3 <- create_complete(4) %>% 
        mutate(name = toupper(letters[11:14]))
    gr4 <- play_islands(n_islands = 4, size_islands = 3, p_within = 1, m_between = 1) %>% 
        mutate(name = toupper(letters[1:12]))
    gr <- bind_graphs(gr1) %>% 
        bind_graphs(gr3) %>% 
        graph_join(gr4) %>% 
        simplify()
    p <- ggraph(gr, layout = 'kk') 
    p <- p + geom_edge_link(color = "steelblue", width = 1.15) 
    p <- p + geom_node_point(color = "tan2", size = 22) 
    p <- p + geom_node_text(aes(label = name), size = 12, color = "white")
    p <- p + theme_graph() 
    p
```

- $\{A, C, D, E\}$

- $\{A, B, C, E\}$

- $\{A, B, D, E\}$

(@) What edges would have to be added to the graph shown in Figure \@ref(fig:clique) to make nodes $\{B, D, G, H, I\}$ into a clique of size 5?

- $\{BG, BI, DH, DG\}$

```{r equiv, fig.height=12, fig.width=12,fig.cap="An undirected graph."}
    set.seed(123)
    pm <- matrix(c( 0,.7,.5, 1, 
                   .7,.7,.2, 0,
                   .5,.2,.7, 0,
                    1, 0, 0, 0), nrow=4)
    pm[lower.tri(pm)] = t(pm)[lower.tri(pm)]
    gr <- play_blocks(n = 12, size_blocks = c(2, 4, 3, 3), p_between = pm) %>% 
        simplify()
    n <- length(V(gr))
    labs <- toupper(letters[1:n])
    V(gr)$name <- labs
    p <- ggraph(gr, layout = 'lgl') 
    p <- p + geom_edge_link(color = "steelblue", width = 1.07) 
    p <- p + geom_node_point(color = "tan2", size = 20) 
    p <- p + geom_node_text(aes(label = name), size = 10, color = "white")
    p <- p + theme_graph() 
    p
```

(@) Fill out the **Structural Similarity Matrix** for the graph shown in Figure \@ref(fig:equiv) using the [**Dice Similarity Index**](http://olizardo.bol.ucla.edu/classes/soc-111/lessons-winter-2022/11-groups-and-positions.html#dice-similarity) metric (3pts).

```{r} 
    J <- round(similarity(gr, method = "dice"), 2)
    rownames(J) <- V(gr)$name
    colnames(J) <- V(gr)$name
    diag(J) <- "--"
    J[lower.tri(J)] <- "--"
    kbl(J, format = "html", align = "c", padding = 1,
        caption = "Structural similarities for pairs of nodes in an undirected graph (Dice).") %>% 
        kable_classic(lightable_options = "striped") %>% 
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed", "responsive")) %>% 
        row_spec(1:nrow(J), color = "black", extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid;") %>% 
        column_spec(1:ncol(J), color = "black", border_right = TRUE, border_left = TRUE)
```

(@) Write down the set of nodes that are **structurally equivalent** (e.g., connected to the same set of neighbors) in Figure \@ref(fig:equiv). 

- $\{J, K, L\}$

(@) Out of the nodes that are not structurally equivalent, which pairs of nodes have the highest **structural similarity** in Figure \@ref(fig:equiv)?

- $A, B$
- $C, E$
- $F, H$
